## Known biases

The 1 m grid is a patchwork of lidar projects from 2013 to 2025, none from the Ida year; the city product is 1 ft and from 2017, so buildings, grading and drainage changes since then are absent. Bare-earth models remove buildings; hydro-flattening and hydro-enforcement alter water bodies and culverts, which matters for pluvial flooding.
